text:
Predicates:
Winner(x, y) ::: x is the winner of y.
Participated(x, y) ::: x participated in y.
TieGroup(x, y) ::: x is in a tie group y.
FromTieGroup(x, y) ::: x is from a tie group y.
FromCountry(x, y) ::: x is from country y.
Leaderboard(y) ::: y is the leaderboard of an event.
Year(y, z) ::: y occurred in year z.
People(x) ::: x is a person.

Premises:
Winner(Steinhauer, duMaurier1992) ::: Steinhauer was the winner of the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
Participated(Steinhauer, duMaurier1992) ::: Steinhauer participated in the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
∃x (TieGroup(x, sixWayTie) ∧ ∃y (FromCountry(y, Belgium) ∧ FromTieGroup(y, x))) ::: There was a six-way tie on the leaderboard, and one person in the six-way tie was from Belgium.
Descampe ∈ Belgium ::: Descampe is from Belgium.
Participated(Descampe, duMaurier1992) ::: Descampe participated in the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
∀x (Participated(x, duMaurier1992) → x ∈ People) ::: All people on the leaderboard participated in the 1992 du Maurier Classic.

Conclusion:
Descampe ∈ TieGroup(y, sixWayTie) ::: Descampe is in the six-way tie in the leaderboard of the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
